revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 4.7% and FY2025 5.1% (filed revenue); fade toward mature-retailer growth near 3.5%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2026 filed margin 29,825/713,163 = 4.18%; no expansion assumed.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate approx 25.7% (1-21,893/29,469, before NCI); ~25% used (21% federal + state/foreign).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 3.5% of revenue (23,783/680,985), FY2026 3.7%; 3.5% used, still above D&A 2.0% as automation/supply-chain investment continues. Note: this elevated capex depresses explicit-period FCF and is a main reason terminal value is a high share of EV.

wacc.source: CAPM: 10Y UST 4.86% (Treasury 2026-11-06) + assumed beta ~0.75 (assumption; low-beta defensive retailer) x US ERP 4.46% (Damodaran 2026-02-16) = ~8.2% cost of equity; debt 44.8B (FY2026) small vs market cap, after-tax cost of debt ~4%; blended ~7.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: 2.0%, at/below long-run inflation, lowered from 2.5% to reduce reliance on terminal value; well below 4.86% risk-free rate. Terminal value share of EV remains high (inherent to a 5-year horizon for a stable, low-margin compounder); reviewer should treat as a flagged limitation.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 44,762 (LTD noncurrent 34,624 + current 3,542 + short-term borrowings 6,596) - cash 10,727; 10-K 0000104169-26-000055; excludes leases
